trigger: The v1 aggregation gate found that independently uniform p10 and p25 calendar-date samples were not nested.
scope: Data-efficiency training only; the completed p100 five-seed main matrix and all locked-test policies remain unchanged.

superseded_results.reason: The independently sampled p10 dates are not a subset of p25. The p25 uniform selection is unchanged and remains eligible.
superseded_results.deletion_policy: Retain all v1 runs and logs as an audit trail; do not cite them as data-efficiency results.

selection_rule.p25: Uniformly spaced fixed positions over sorted p100 training dates, count round(0.25*N).
selection_rule.p10: Uniformly spaced fixed positions over the frozen p25 dates, count round(0.10*N_total).
selection_rule.p100: All registered training dates from tartan_retrain_protocol_v1.
selection_rule.nested: p10 is a subset of p25, and p25 is a subset of p100.

training.reuse_p25_and_p100: Existing runs are reused only after exact selected-date identity checks against this amendment.

claim_boundary: Exploratory seed-42 development-only learning curves; the v2 amendment repairs nesting and is not confirmatory evidence.
